v0.205.0.message:
The Agent-KV extraction API moved from `/api/v1/agent-kv/` to
`/api/v1/agentic-extract/` (UN-4044). The old path is no longer served.

This only matters if your deployment carries the Agent-KV engine plugin
(`backend/plugins/agent_kv/`, e.g. copied in by `copy_cloud_deps.py`).
An OSS-only stack refuses this API with a 501 either way and needs nothing.

ACTION, if it applies: your `backend/.env` keeps whatever
`AGENT_KV_PATH_PREFIX` it already had -- this update preserves it -- so the
backend may still be serving the old path. Delete that line from
`backend/.env` to take the new default. Edit `backend/.env`, not
`docker/.env`, which the backend does not read.

To see which path your build serves, send one request with NO
Authorization header. Use the host your stack is actually fronted on --
the shipped Compose router only sends /api/v1 to the backend for
`frontend.unstract.localhost`, so plain `localhost` returns a router 404
whichever prefix is live:
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' \
      http://frontend.unstract.localhost/api/v1/agentic-extract/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
403 means that prefix is live. 401 means it is not, and you are on the old
one. 404 means you did not reach the backend at all -- check the host.

Callers left on the old path get `401 Invalid or inactive API key`, which
looks like a bad credential and is a stale URL -- check the path before
rotating any key. Full detail: docs/agent-kv-api.md section 11, item 12.
